avis.titre: Hydrating, plumping, and surprisingly soothing — great for mature skinHydrating, plumping, and surprisingly soothing — g
avis.texte: This serum really impressed me. At 52 with post-menopause skin, hydration and bounce are always my main concerns, and this formula delivers both without feeling heavy. The texture is a lightweight watery gel that absorbs instantly, and I love how it layers with my other products without pilling. The blend of hyaluronic acid, peptides, and PDRN gives my skin a nice plumped look — especially first thing in the morning. My fine lines look softer, and the overall texture of my skin feels smoother and more hydrated throughout the day. It also has a calming effect, which I wasn’t expecting. On days when my skin feels a little irritated or dry from retinol, this serum takes that tight feeling away almost immediately. What I appreciate most is that it gives visible glow and moisture but doesn’t make my skin greasy or sticky. It plays really well under makeup and doesn’t interfere with my other serums or moisturizers. For the price, the ingredient list is impressive, and the performance absolutely measures up. If your skin needs hydration, plumping, and a little repair boost, this is a great option — especially for mature or sensitive skin like mine.

avis.titre: Game-Changer for Hydrated, Glowy Skin. Pores Look Smaller & Texture Feels Silky Smooth!Game-Changer for Hydrated, Glowy
avis.texte: I have combination skin with some melasma, and this serum has been working really well for me. The texture is light and silky, it absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave that greasy or sticky feeling that some serums do. I’ve noticed my skin looks more hydrated and smoother since I started using it — my makeup goes on better and my skin feels softer throughout the day. It also layers nicely with sunscreen or moisturizer, no pilling at all. The packaging is simple but feels nice quality, and I love that it doesn’t have a strong scent. It’s one of those products that just quietly does its job really well. If you’re looking for hydration and that subtle healthy glow, this one’s definitely worth a try💧.

avis.titre: Medicube’s Crystal-Blue Serum Delivers Glow, Bounce, and Barrier Repair
avis.texte: Medicube’s Hyaluronic Multi Peptide PDRN Serum is a hydration-focused formula designed to soothe, plump, and brighten the skin. With a blend of multi-weight hyaluronic acids, peptides, and regenerative actives, it targets dullness and dehydration while supporting barrier repair and elasticity. The serum is especially well-suited for those seeking a glowy, even-toned complexion without heaviness or irritation. My serum arrived in a blue Medicube box about 1¾ inches square and just over 4 inches tall. Inside was a clear dropper bottle with a white dropper top and a crystal blue liquid. The packaging feels clean and clinical with a touch of K-beauty polish—Medicube’s signature aesthetic. The dropper dispenses a precise amount of product, and the bottle’s transparency allows you to appreciate the serum’s vibrant hue and track usage easily. Ingredients are listed on the box in both English and Korean, and I’ve included the full INCI list at the end of this review. The formula is built around a robust hydration matrix, featuring multiple forms of hyaluronic acid—Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, and Dimethylsilanol Hyaluronate—designed to penetrate and retain moisture at various skin depths. PDRN (Sodium DNA), a regenerative active derived from salmon DNA, supports skin healing and elasticity. avis.titre: Chock full of not only an onslaught of peptides but many, MANY botanical extracts as well!!!
avis.texte: Medicube Hyaluronic and Multi Peptide Serum not only has a huge amount of peptides, but an impressive list of botanical extracts and oils!! I have used for almost a week now, under my makeup and also layer with other products before bed. It is a super-hydrater, and really pumps up my skin!! I very much love the fel-like texture, and that there are no chemical dyes!! There are at least 3 chemicals in this that I don't care for, but far less than even the many spendy serums and creams out there, so I can't harp on that too much!! It's just over an oz for $21.80, and while that seems like a lot, you can use this sparingly and it really does pack a punch of goodness and moisture!!

avis.titre: As a skincare specialist and as the ingredient police, I like this product overall
avis.texte: I have been known as "The Ingredient Police" for about 40 years (I'm 60) and as a skincare specialist with a DIY soul i make a lot of my own skincare (and lipgloss and nail polish which i share on my channel) and this is my first time using hyaluronic acid. I've seen a lot of data about it and went into it not 100% sure that it would make a difference used topically. After one use, I still feel this way. I will continue to use it and let you know if i end up finding it miraculous. Having said that, i very much like what I see in the ingredient list beyond hyaluronic acid and thats why I decided that this would be the one that I go ahead and try. Of course I did 2 patch tests 24 hours apart and even with my crazy sensitive skin, I had no problems. So today it went on my face. I do feel nice and dewy but not sticky. And I would say that i do see a subtle softening of my parentheses and other fine lines. That is about the most I'd expect out of all of the other ingredients. Hyaluronic acid for topical use wise - I'm still not sure i buy the hype. All of that said it do very much like this product and approve of the rest of its ingredients for sure. I hope my review was helpful to you.💜💜💜

avis.titre: helpful addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: I like that this is a serum that plays well with the rest of my skincare routine. I have been using it for my nighttime routine and it recently has become my last step and I've foregone the night cream just to see if this can keep my face moisturized without a cream (I use a facial mist, toner, 2 other serums and then this as my last step). Together, they have kept me moisturized well into the next day. (Sometimes I don't need to leave the house, so I just let it linger till the afternoon and my face still feels very moisturized). It certainly offers a plump cheek feeling, but that could just be my current face situation!

It's really important to shake this before using as some of the emulsions float to the top. You have to shake it quite a bit to make the emulsions really turn into a solution that's even in the dropper. Otherwise the dropper will pick up big drops of some of the emulsions and not of the others. I have Fair sensitive skin and after a few days of using I have no irritation which is nice. I do have a small breakout on my chin which could be incidental or it could be from trying a new product. Time will tell

avis.titre: biphase serum with TONS of great skincare ingredients
avis.texte: I love Medicube skincare, and this new biphase serum covers SO many skincare ingredient bases, effectively replacing multiple others in my routine. It has hydrating HA, moisturizing squalane, PDRN, and a long list of peptides. It settles in to a bilayer when not in use; just give it a good shake and it mixes quickly. It goes on feeling slippery and takes a few minutes to dry down, leaving nothing sticky, just soft and hydrated skin. This will work well for me with microneedling. No fragrance, which is always a bonus!

-You get 1.01fl oz of Facial Serum and it is made in Korea -I use this serum on my clean face after using a toner -This light blue serum is non greasy and non sticky -I love that it is fragrance free and scentless -This keeps my face hydrated and brightens my face
